cohort.selection: First16 eligible fresh acquisition blocks in ascending ID, assessed after complete four-block waves. Same boundary-only rule-balanced minimum-hash selector: two g14 failures and two successes per block. Retain all attempts, rejections and surplus. No target futures until the entire16-block cohort is sealed. No replacement after future outcomes.

primary.endpoint: Mean original-rule success fraction at g16..33 across four original g14 packets per block, then across16 fresh acquisition blocks.
primary.criterion: Single paired acquisition-block contrast: ongoing current-success guard minus one successful rewrite then retain, under independent noise. Support iff nondegenerate one-sided95% t lower>0; contradiction iff nondegenerate one-sided95% upper<=0; otherwise unresolved. No optional stopping, sample extension, primary substitution or equivalence claim.
primary.inference: 16 fresh acquisition blocks are the paired uncertainty unit, df15. Packets, repeated reads and arms are not independent replicates. Same declared acquisition/selection distribution, policies, horizon and disturbance. Approximate paired t intervals; hypothesis and sample informed by exposed development data.

sample_size_planning.budget_rationale: Largest tested cohort size in four-block increments whose conservative full-cap cost leaves room for a four-worker qualification wave inside3600 seconds. All five policies, native dynamics and primary contrast are retained. Choose sample before any new acquisition; no later down-sizing.

target_actual_deadline: Earlier of startup+3600seconds and target_start+3400seconds. Qualification timing gate charges the entire20-attempt acquisition cap and all16 continuations before new scientific acquisition.
